takes.h: The Raven Society adds a ghostly R.I.P. Edgar Allan Poe
takes.p: Bleeding Cool reports BigBadWorkShop’s The Raven Society line includes a campaign-exclusive R.I.P. Edgar Allan Poe Founder Edition, a 1:12 figure with over 20 points of articulation and glow-in-the-dark elements. Accessories include a quill, crow, skull, books, journal, cat and smoke effects. Chapter One of the campaign is fully funded.
